system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 Mystwalker abilities, and the Veil must have torn at least once while you thinned it

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: Self

You become akin to a spirit (or demon) yourself.

As an Action, you step half through the Veil and stay there: your body walks in the world, and your soul burns shines from Urdokai through the Veil like fire through paper.

  • Your Body and Soul increase by +2.

  • You can see every creature behind the Veil within 10 spaces of you.

  • Attacks without the Magical trait cannot harm you. Attacks with the Magical trait, spells, and Path abilities affect you as normal.

  • Once per round, on your turn, when you use an ability with the Mystwalker trait, you may reduce its cost by 1 Resolve.

  • You have Advantage on Attacks made with Mystwalker against demons, spirits, and sacred beasts.

  • Spirits, demons, and sacred beasts have Disadvantage on checks made to resist your your spells and abilities.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, spirits, demons, and sacred beasts will afford you a special respect.
